stories.title: Indian Startup Funding Surges 826% to $290 Mn as 23 Startups Raise Capital This Week - TechStory
Bloom raises $75 million for AI expansion
stories.summary: Travel and hospitality brand Bloom has raised $75 million from Kedaara Capital to develop its technology and product offerings. The company plans to focus on artificial intelligence and dynamic pricing to improve customer experience. Bloom reports a 30% compound annual growth rate over the past five years.

stories.title: Redbrick Offices secures Rs 630 crore in funding
stories.summary: Managed workspace provider Redbrick Offices has raised Rs 630 crore in Series A and A1 rounds led by India SME Investments and Abakkus Asset Manager. The funding includes a primary infusion and a secondary component for existing shareholders. The company had previously operated as a bootstrapped business.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises Rs 101 crore
stories.summary: NBFC InPrime Finserv has raised Rs 101 crore in a Series B round led by FMO. The startup, which lends to small business owners in the informal economy, plans to use the capital to expand its product reach and enter the micro-mortgage segment. This round doubles its previous funding.

stories.title: Boba Bhai raises $18 million in Series B
stories.summary: Quick-service restaurant chain Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in a Series B round led by Left Lane Capital. The company intends to use its existing infrastructure and supply chain to introduce new food concepts and expand its retail footprint under the Boba Bhai Ventures parent entity.

stories.title: Soket AI secures $4 million for on-premise models
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Soket AI has raised nearly $4 million from Bajaj Finance and Pennant Technologies. The research lab is building indigenous large language models under the government's IndiaAI Mission. The company has not disclosed its valuation for the seed round.

stories.title: Cashify reports first annual profit
stories.summary: Recommerce platform Cashify reported a net profit of Rs 6.5 crore in FY26, following a net loss of Rs 10.6 crore in the previous year. Revenue grew 50% to Rs 1,641.2 crore, driven by demand for refurbished electronics. The company has finally moved past its years of persistent losses.

stories.title: Style Union raises Rs 485 crore
stories.summary: Value fashion retailer Style Union has raised Rs 485 crore in a Series E round led by Venturi Partners and Elev8 Venture Partners. The company plans to use the primary and secondary capital to strengthen its presence in northern and western India and expand its store network.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises Rs 101 crore for AI lending
stories.summary: InPrime Finserv has raised Rs 101 crore in a Series B round led by FMO. The NBFC plans to invest in agentic AI for underwriting and customer service. Existing investors Z47 and Pravega Ventures also participated in the round, which brings institutional backing to the company's lending operations.

stories.title: Boltz raises $110 million for AI drug discovery
stories.summary: London-based AI drug discovery startup Boltz has raised $110 million in a Series A round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company plans to spend the funds on compute, data, and new hires. Nvidia previously invested in the startup during a visit by Jensen Huang.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million
stories.summary: French robotics startup Genesis AI has raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation. The round was co-led by Khosla Ventures, Premji Invest, and Eclipse. The company plans to use the capital to increase production of its general-purpose robot, Eno, and expand its AI training capabilities.

stories.summary: Aikido Security, a Ghent-based security software developer, is in talks to raise a fresh funding round at a €4bn valuation, over four times the value it secured in January. stories.title: Hoplite raises $5.5 million for AI coding agents
stories.summary: AI startup Hoplite has raised $5.5 million to build a platform for developers to run AI coding agents in the cloud. The company describes its product as the easiest way to manage autonomous software-writing programs. Backers include Stripe founders and Paul Graham.

stories.title: PIDG invests $11.7 million in NEPRA
stories.summary: The Private Infrastructure Development Group has invested Rs 110 crore in Ahmedabad-based waste management company NEPRA. This marks the group's first equity investment in the Asian recycling sector. NEPRA operates an integrated platform that handles waste collection, segregation, and material recovery.

stories.title: Canada joins NATO Innovation Fund with $100 million commitment
stories.summary: Canada has formally joined the NATO Innovation Fund, committing more than $100 million to support defence and dual-use startups. The fund, which National Defence describes as the world's first multi-sovereign venture capital vehicle, now provides Canadian innovators access to more than €1 billion in deployable capital.

stories.title: Swish revenue grows as losses widen
stories.summary: Food delivery startup Swish reported operating revenue of ₹47.6 Cr in its first fiscal year, a 10-fold increase. However, net losses surged to ₹91.1 Cr as expenses rose. The startup was incorporated in July 2024, making year-on-year comparisons based on a partial operating period.

stories.title: New-Age Tech Stocks Miss Market Rally This Week, Paytm Sheds 10.8%
stories.summary: New-age tech stocks largely missed the rally in Indian equities this week, with only 22 of the 69 stocks under Inc42’s coverage ending higher. stories.title: Fi Money reports revenue decline alongside narrowed losses
stories.summary: Fintech startup Fi Money narrowed its consolidated net loss by 25 percent to ₹153.3 Cr in FY26. Operating revenue fell 21 percent to ₹38.7 Cr during the same period. The company says the reduction in losses reflects a shrinking scale rather than improved profitability.

stories.title: Traya revenue grows 73 percent as losses increase
stories.summary: Haircare brand Traya reported operating revenue of ₹585.1 Cr for FY26, a 73 percent increase over the previous year. Net losses also rose by 23 percent to ₹29 Cr. The startup's EBITDA margin improved slightly to negative 4.81 percent from negative 6.25 percent.

stories.title: First Circle Capital closes $26 million African fintech fund
stories.summary: Venture capital firm First Circle Capital has closed its debut fund at $26 million, exceeding its initial $25 million target. The vehicle will back pre-seed and seed-stage fintech startups across Africa, with a specific focus on AI-native companies. The exact closing date remains undisclosed.

stories.title: River Mobility revenue jumps as losses widen
stories.summary: Electric two-wheeler maker River Mobility reported operating revenue of ₹432.3 Cr for FY26, a four-fold increase. Net losses widened 46 percent to ₹285.7 Cr as the company ramped up production. Total expenses for the year increased 140 percent to ₹719.1 Cr.

stories.title: Bending Spoons acquires Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
stories.summary: Bending Spoons has purchased email marketing firm Mailchimp from Intuit for $3.68 billion. Intuit acquired the company in 2021 for approximately $12 billion. The sale marks a significant loss for the tax-preparation giant, which has been navigating the impact of AI on its software business.

stories.title: Anthropic Nasdaq debut draws Indian retail investors
stories.summary: Indian retail investors traded Anthropic shares heavily following the company's Nasdaq debut. Platforms including INDmoney and Mudrex reported that the AI firm accounted for up to 40 percent of international trading activity. Average order values on some platforms were double the typical daily volume.

Startup sues Apple for 15 billion rupees over NameDrop patent
stories.summary: GG Technologies, a US startup, has sued Apple in the Bombay High Court. The company claims the iPhone NameDrop feature infringes on its patent for contact sharing. It seeks 15 billion rupees in damages and an injunction to disable the feature in India. Mediation failed in September.

stories.summary: Apple is facing a ₹15 billion (around $161.86 million) patent infringement lawsuit in India from US-based startup GG Technologies, which claims the iPhone maker's NameDrop feature uses technology covered by its patent. stories.title: AI agents may soon recommend layoffs, says startup CEO
stories.summary: Michael Ioffe, CEO of AI startup Arist, predicts that AI agents will soon help CEOs decide which employees to fire. He expects these agents to recommend the majority of significant enterprise shifts, including product launches and staff reductions, within the next few years. The software has not yet commented.

stories.title: Documentary revisits the public portrayal of Elizabeth Holmes
stories.summary: A new documentary titled You Can See Everything examines the public image of Elizabeth Holmes in the decade leading up to her 2023 prison sentence for investor fraud. The film analyzes how gendered narratives were used to frame the former health tech founder during her rise and fall.

stories.title: Venture funding for HR and recruiting startups hits 4 billion dollars
stories.summary: Investors have poured nearly 4 billion dollars into global recruiting and HR startups so far this year, according to Crunchbase data. Most of these companies are incorporating AI into their platforms to manage payroll and hiring. Capital continues to flow toward finding jobs for actual humans.
